title: Initial Public Release: The Autonomous AI Workbench
description: Mash 0.1.0 introduces a local-first engineering and forensic audit environment combining autonomous agent reasoning with a dual-pane 3D spreadsheet workspace.

highlights.text: Dual-pane AI workbench pairing conversational agent execution with an 880px interactive spreadsheet canvas.
Native 3D vector chart renderer supporting real-time spatial projection of financial time-series and audit ledgers.
Local tool harness: Autonomous agent can search files, read spreadsheets, write deliverables, and run sandboxed shell commands.
Focused single-pane chat mode with expandable step-by-step thinking traces and execution token inspector.
Verified Windows x64 NSIS installer (224.54 MB) with SHA-256 binary integrity enforcement.
